#!/bin/bash
# Usage: sweep.sh <fuzzer_bin> <seedfile>
# Try a sweep of OOM failure points; report which (seed, fail_after) crashes.
BIN="$1"
SEED="$2"
export LD_PRELOAD=/workspace/oomfuzz/fail.so
for af in $(seq 0 2 300); do
  OOM_FAIL_AFTER=$af "$BIN" "$SEED" >/dev/null 2>/tmp/sweep.err
  rc=$?
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "CRASH seed=$SEED fail_after=$af rc=$rc"
    head -30 /tmp/sweep.err
    return 0 2>/dev/null
  fi
done
echo "none seed=$SEED"
